title: Safe by Accident: Crash-Testing LLM-Written Code
abstract: arXiv:2611.10585v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Evaluations of LLM-written code run it once, in one environment, and credit the code with whatever passes. We show that this credit can belong to the environment. We crashed LLM-written backend code just before each database, file and email call, re-ran it as an operator would, and judged the result under two transaction modes of Python's sqlite3: the default, in which the library quietly opens a transaction, and autocommit, in which it does not. Across 9,100 solutions from ten models on 24 backend tasks, more than half (54%) of the database code that survives every crash in the default mode is left half-updated in autocommit mode. This holds for every model, and it hides in ordinary code, including with conn: blocks that look like transactions but open none. Telling the model that its connection is in autocommit mode does not change what the local code models write, while the API models' unsafe share falls by 30 points. Asking for c

translated_title: 偶然的安全：对大语言模型生成代码的崩溃测试
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.10585v2（公告类型：replace）摘要：对大语言模型（LLM）所写代码的评估通常只运行一次、仅在一个环境中进行，并将通过测试归功于代码本身。我们证明这种“功劳”可能属于环境。我们在每次数据库、文件和邮件调用之前让 LLM 编写的后端代码崩溃，然后像运维人员那样重新运行，并在 Python sqlite3 的两种事务模式下评判结果：默认模式（库会静默地开启一个事务）和自动提交模式（autocommit，不会开启事务）。在对十个模型在 24 个后端任务上共 9,100 个解的测试中，在默认模式下经受住每一次崩溃的数据库代码，有超过一半（54%）在自动提交模式下会处于“半更新”（部分写入）状态。这一现象在每个模型上都成立，且隐藏在普通代码之中，包括那些看起来像事务但实际上并未开启事务的 “with conn:” 代码块。告知模型其连接处于自动提交模式并不会改变本地模型所写的代码，而 API 模型的不安全代码比例下降了 30 个百分点。要求……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文通过对 9,100 个 LLM 生成的后端代码进行崩溃测试发现，54% 在 sqlite3 默认事务模式下能通过崩溃测试的数据库代码，在自动提交模式下会留下半更新状态，证明现有“单次运行、单一环境”的代码评估把通过归功于环境而非代码本身的安全性。
en_tdlr: By crash-testing 9,100 LLM-written backend solutions under two sqlite3 transaction modes, the paper shows that 54% of code surviving crashes in default mode is left half-updated in autocommit mode, revealing that single-run, single-environment evaluations credit the environment rather than the code's actual safety.
